answer: Entry to the grader set requires a 120 POA voyage bond that stays locked until eight distinct established miners have countersigned the same key across three successive epochs. A second identity must post its own 120 POA; if two keys emit a byte-identical answer or opposite grades on one seat, both bonds are forfeited to the attesting set. Remaining lock, required signatures, and slash events are public, so a dune of unpaid aliases cannot join the panel even when a registration gale arrives at epoch open.
